messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync 11 starting a short thread for the Nova Systems co-host SKU: need legal, marketplace, and SI alignment. Target announce week: 2026-04-12. Main asks: redistribution terms, embargo cadence, marketplace assets, and SI staging checklist. Who will own which items?

Sam (Legal): I can take legal addendum. Need: upstream model license (full text), any partner-suggested addenda, and contact for signatures. High-level checklist:
- confirm license type + redistribution permissions
- attribution / NOTICE requirements
- export-control screening (EAR/ITAR) via export@redwood.com
- commercial addendum covering revenue split and reseller rights
- KMS/HSM obligations if they want downloads or private-hosted weights
- indemnity/warranty limitations for marketplace listing
I can draft initial addendum by Tuesday if you hand me the base license and partner contact.

Diego (Product): Tech requirements to feed Legal & Marketplace:
- artifacts to be delivered: server container, float16 weights, and quantized GGML variants
- perf matrix required: p50/p95 latency on H100 and A10, and memory footprints per variant
- manifest schema we expect for the marketplace (simple example):
```json
{
  "name": "nova-open-13b",
  "variants": ["float16","ggml-q8_0"],
  "hash": "sha256:...",
  "recommended": {"gpu": ["H100","A100"], "min_ram_gb": "32"}
}
```
I can own the manifest + perf docs 11 ETA: Friday EOD.

Rachel (Marketplace): Listing/publisher checklist: 
- marketing blurb (<= 300 chars), high-res logo (PNG/SVG), and 2 sample inference traces/screenshots
- SKU id (we'll mint it), supported deploy modes: hosted, download, private (VPC)
- pricing guidance: per-token hosted + suggested download fee (partner to propose)
- SLA targets for Dedicated offers + incident contact
- support contact mapping (partner SE + Redwood triage)
- staging listing URL: https://marketplace.staging.redwood/partners (we'll mark embargoed)
Need assets by next Wednesday to meet the April 12 publish.

Owen (SolutionsEng): SI integration / staging checklist: 
- compatibility matrix for H100, A100, A10, and common edge inference tiles
- helm chart + values.yaml for cohost orchestration; will add template snippet to repo
- smoke tests: basic inference, kv-cache sanity, and perf regression check
- require a `run_smoke.sh` that exits 0 on success and prints minimal trace
- CI: we'll deploy partner container to staging and run smoke tests; need registry creds or signed artifacts
I can run staging Wed/Thu once I have the container and creds.

Maya (Partnerships): Owners recap: 
- Legal addendum & signoffs: Sam (due Tue)
- Manifest + perf: Diego (due Fri)
- Marketplace assets & pricing: Rachel (assets due Wed)
- SI staging + helm: Owen (staging Wed/Thu)
Question: embargo cadence 11 hard publish for all vs staggered (hosted first, downloads later)? Opinions?

Sam (Legal): I prefer staggered: hosted listing + hosted API first, downloads allowed 48-72 hours later after signatures. Adds a short contractual buffer. I'll include the fallback routing clause (see Diego's note) and require partner signoff on operational fallback policy.

Rachel (Marketplace): Staggered is fine. We'll set the marketplace record to `embargoed` in staging and a `publish_time` field. Ops will un-hide downloads after legal confirms. Need pricing numbers by EOD Tue to populate the draft listing.

Owen (SolutionsEng): I need partner registry access and example `values.yaml` by EOD Tue. Also confirm whether downloads are hosted on our S3 (Redwood-origin) or partner-origin S3 — that changes KMS flow.

Diego (Product): One technical nuance for Legal: we want the cohost router to be able to fallback to quantized variants when float16 capacity is exhausted. That affects user-perceived quality; Legal: is special wording required?

Sam (Legal): Yes. Add an operational routing clause stating: Redwood may route to approved quantized variants when primary variants are unavailable; partner must approve fallback policy and accept different accuracy characteristics for those variants. I'll draft that into the addendum.

announce-bot: Calendar event created: "Nova co-host SKU: legal+marketplace+SI sync" Thu 09:00 PT 11 https://calendar.redwood/events/novacohost123 :calendar:

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll assemble a short linked doc in the partnerships drive with Sam's draft, Diego's manifest template, and the staging listing URL. If anyone can't hit deadlines, reply here. :thumbsup: 

Sam (Legal): ACK.

Owen (SolutionsEng): I'll push a minimal helm.values template and tag the staging repo when ready.

Rachel (Marketplace): Copy 11 reserving the announce slot and will set the `publish_time` once legal signs off.

Diego (Product): Sending perf matrix + manifest by EOD Fri.

Maya (Partnerships): Closing thread unless blockers emerge.
